title: Advanced Matka Gambling App with Real Money Betting

requirements.text: Rebuild the backend as a Matka gambling platform actor. Replace all existing APK-related logic with: user registration and profile management (username, balance in paise as Nat), deposit and withdrawal request tracking, Matka game result management (open/close numbers, Jodi, Panna), bet placement with market types (Single, Jodi, Single Panna, Double Panna, Triple Panna), and result declaration with automatic payout calculation based on standard Matka odds.

quotes: Create advance matka app working with real money

acceptanceCriteria: User can register and their balance is stored as Nat (paise units) in stable memory
User can place bets on open/close digits, Jodi (00–99), and Panna combinations
Backend validates sufficient balance before accepting any bet
Admin can declare results (open number, close number) for a market
Winning bets are automatically calculated and balances credited using standard Matka odds (Single 9x, Jodi 90x, Single Panna 150x, Double Panna 300x, Triple Panna 600x)
Deposit and withdrawal requests are stored with status (pending/approved/rejected) and can be managed by admin
All state is stored in stable variables to survive canister upgrades

requirements.text: Create an Admin panel page accessible only to the canister controller/admin principal. Admin can: declare game results for active markets, manage market open/close schedules, view all pending deposit and withdrawal requests, approve or reject deposit/withdrawal requests, and view overall platform statistics (total bets, total payout, active users).

quotes: Create advance matka app working with real money

acceptanceCriteria: Admin panel is hidden from non-admin users
Admin can declare open and close numbers for any active market
Admin can approve or reject pending deposit/withdrawal requests
Admin sees total platform stats: active users, total bets today, total payout today
Admin actions trigger immediate backend state updates

requirements.text: Build a Market Lobby page showing all active Matka markets (e.g., Kalyan, Milan Day, Rajdhani Night). Each market card must display: market name, open time, close time, last result (open digit + Jodi + close digit), and current market status (betting open / waiting for result / result declared). Users must be logged in via Internet Identity to place bets.

quotes: Create advance matka app working with real money

acceptanceCriteria: Market lobby shows all seeded markets with name, open/close time, and status
Last result is displayed in standard Matka format (e.g., 3 45 6)
Markets with closed betting show a disabled state
Clicking a market navigates to the bet placement page for that market
Unauthenticated users see a login prompt before accessing bet placement

requirements.text: Build a Bet Placement page for each market. The page must support all bet types: Single (open/close digit 0–9), Jodi (00–99), Single Panna, Double Panna, and Triple Panna. User selects bet type, enters their number selection, enters bet amount (minimum ₹10), and submits. Show current wallet balance and deduct it immediately on successful bet. Display a confirmation with expected payout.

quotes: Create advance matka app working with real money

acceptanceCriteria: All five bet types are selectable with appropriate number input constraints
Minimum bet amount is ₹10 (1000 paise)
Current wallet balance is displayed and validated before submission
On successful bet, balance is deducted and a confirmation with expected payout is shown
Backend rejects bets if market is closed or balance is insufficient
Expected payout is calculated and shown before confirmation

requirements.text: Build a Wallet page where users can: view current balance in INR, submit a deposit request (amount + UTR/transaction reference number), submit a withdrawal request (amount + UPI ID or bank details), and view the full transaction history including bet placements, winnings, deposits, and withdrawals with statuses.

quotes: Create advance matka app working with real money

acceptanceCriteria: Wallet page shows balance in formatted INR (e.g., ₹1,250.00)
Deposit form accepts amount and UTR reference and submits to backend as a pending request
Withdrawal form accepts amount and UPI ID and submits to backend as a pending request
Transaction history lists all wallet events with date, type, amount, and status
Deposit and withdrawal requests show pending/approved/rejected status

requirements.text: Build a My Bets / Results page showing the authenticated user's full bet history. Each row shows: market name, bet type, selected number, bet amount, result (win/loss/pending), and payout amount. Group bets by date with the most recent first.

quotes: Create advance matka app working with real money

acceptanceCriteria: All bets for the authenticated user are fetched and displayed
Each bet row shows market, type, number, amount, and outcome
Won bets show the payout amount in green; lost bets in red; pending in amber
Bets are grouped by date, newest first

requirements.text: Apply a bold Indian gambling/Matka visual theme across the entire app. Use a dark background with deep red and gold as primary accent colors, traditional Matka wheel/playing card motifs, bold typography for numbers and results, and a responsive mobile-first layout. Replace all APK-related branding, copy, and navigation with Matka-specific equivalents.

quotes: Create advance matka app working with real money

acceptanceCriteria: App title, logo area, and page title reflect Matka branding
Color scheme uses dark background with red/gold accents consistently
Navigation includes: Markets, My Bets, Wallet, and Admin (admin only)
All APK-related pages, routes, and components are removed
Layout is mobile-first and usable on small screens

constraints: All monetary values must be stored as Nat in paise (1 INR = 100 paise) to avoid floating point errors
Admin-only functions in the backend must check the caller principal against a hardcoded or stored admin principal
Do not integrate any external payment gateway or third-party API — deposit/withdrawal is manual (admin approves based on UTR/UPI proof)
Internet Identity is the only authentication mechanism
All existing APK-related backend and frontend code must be replaced entirely
nonGoals: Automated payment gateway integration (Razorpay, PayTM, etc.)
SMS OTP or phone number authentication
Live odds feed from external Matka sources

required: Dark Matka gambling app logo with a spinning wheel and gold lettering on a deep red background (matka-logo.dim_256x256.png)
Decorative Matka wheel banner with gold and red tones on dark background for hero section (matka-hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png)
